step.credential = Verify the agent's ATX credential locally
step.grant = Issue a scoped AAP grant
step.crossing = Cross into the supplier's bank's trust domain
step.intent = Apply the intent rule to each tool call
step.pay = Pay the invoice under the grant
step.record = Write one signed Action Evidence Package per action
step.grantAgain = Ask for a new AAP grant
step.payAgain = Pay the invoice under the new grant
step.received = The supplier's bank receives the payment

intent.heading = Intent rule
intent.rule = Every argument of a tool call must equal the same field of the declared intent. A call with no declared intent is blocked.
